answer.because: On head, rendering `![foo `bar`](x)` with the project's own markdown-it gives alt="foo " instead of alt="foo bar" (base gives alt="foo bar"). This shows that with the code_inline case gone, renderInlineAsText drops code-span text from image alt, against CommonMark's stripped-markup rule.
